offers_products.reason: Builds and sells new homes under Ryan Homes, NVHomes and Heartland Homes brands.

offers_services.reason: Homebuilding dominates; mortgage banking and settlement services only support NVR homebuyers and are the smaller segment.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Sells new homes directly to individual homebuyers and families.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Buyers are households; mortgage and settlement services also serve NVR homebuyers only.

recurring_revenue.reason: Home sales are one-time transactions to each buyer.

cyclical_demand.reason: New home purchases are easily postponed in downturns and sensitive to rates.

big_ticket.reason: A new home is the largest, rarest purchase for a household.

people_delivered.reason: Customers buy built homes, a physical product, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are individual homebuyers and households.

asset_heavy.reason: Homebuilder with subcontracted construction and lot option contracts; building component plants exist but are modest.
